pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately serrated edges. Individual patches show dark brown interior tones with slight pixel-level gradients at the boundaries against the lighter matrix.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forming an interconnected network. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pathway thickness varies across the flank, showing relative narrowing at junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck ridge, characterized by dark brown piloerect hair clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the specimen: one located on the dorsal ridge near the posterior visible frame, and one positioned on the ventro-lateral lower neck/chest region.
